item.description: HARRISBURG — Gov. item.title: Judge blocks Trump administration from ending protections for Haitians
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, OHIO — A federal judge on Monday blocked the end of protections that have allowed roughly 350,000 Haitians to live in the U.S., dealing President Donald Trump's immigration agenda another legal, though perhaps temporary, setback. U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes in Washington granted a request to pause the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Haitians while a lawsuit challenging it proceeds. item.title: Shapiro pick for Board of Pardons wins Pa. Senate approval despite opposition from public defenders, clemency advocates
item.description: HARRISBURG — The Pennsylvania Senate on Wednesday confirmed John S. O’Brien II to the Board of Pardons, dooming a pressure campaign from clemency advocates seeking to defeat his nomination. Gov. Josh Shapiro, a Democrat, nominated O’Brien, a doctor and attorney who has made a career as a state’s witness in high-stakes cases.
